content: Supabase-recommended transactional email: an Edge Function calls Resend (npm:resend@^6) via fetch to api.resend.com/emails with RESEND_API_KEY stored as a function secret. For custom auth emails, wire the Supabase Auth 'Send Email' hook with a webhook secret (v1,whsec_...), verify with standardwebhooks npm:standardwebhooks@^1, and render templates with npm:@react-email/components@^1 renderAsync. Deploy with 'supabase functions deploy send-email'; set secrets with 'supabase secrets set --env-file'.
